meta.title: TezDukan: aapki dukan ka maal, bill aur khata
meta.description: Distributor se minton mein maal mangwayein aur poori dukan ek app se chalayein: bill, stock, khata aur reports.

brand.name: TezDukan
brand.tagline: Apni Dukan. Ab Aapke Ghar Tak.

nav.munshiHint: Munshi: tap kar ke likhein ya bolein, daba kar rakhein aur bolein

roles.switchDescription: Role badalne se aap sign out nahi honge.
roles.switched: Ab aap bataur {role} istemal kar rahe hain
roles.switchFailed: Role nahi badla. Dobara koshish karein.

auth.panelTitle: Jaldi maal mangwayein. Poori dukan ek app se chalayein.
auth.panelPoint1: Distributor se minton mein order, saaf munafa aur scheme ke saath.
auth.panelPoint2: Bill, stock aur khata, internet ke baghair bhi.
auth.panelPoint3: Munshi se Urdu, Roman Urdu ya English mein poochein.
auth.panelFooter: Hyderabad ki dukanon ke liye banaya gaya.
auth.loginSubtitle: Apna mobile number aur password likhein.
auth.signupSubtitle: Ek minute lagega. Hum aapke mobile par code bhejenge.
auth.termsNote: Aage barh kar aap TezDukan ki sharait aur privacy policy se ittefaq karte hain.
auth.verifySubtitle: Humne {phone} par 6 hindson ka code bheja hai.
auth.codeSent: Naya code bhej diya gaya hai.
auth.sandboxSmsBody: SMS abhi set nahi hua, is liye code yahan dikhaya ja raha hai.
auth.sandboxUnavailable: Code chand lamhon mein yahan aa jayega. Na aaye to code dobara bhejein.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Hum aapke mobile number par code bhejenge.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password badal gaya. Aap sign in hain.
auth.forgotSandboxBody: Hum abhi reset code nahi bhej sakte. TezDukan team se rabta karein, woh aapka password reset kar denge.

errors.invalidCredentials: Mobile number ya password ghalat hai.
errors.phoneTaken: Is number par pehle se account hai.
errors.invalidCode: Code ghalat hai ya iska waqt khatam ho gaya hai.
errors.tooManyRequests: Bohat zyada koshishein. Ek minute ruk kar dobara koshish karein.
errors.phoneNotConfirmed: Yeh number abhi verify nahi hua. Humne naya code bheja hai.
errors.weakPassword: Mazboot password banayein (kam az kam 8 huroof).
errors.smsFailed: SMS nahi bheja ja saka. Dobara koshish karein.
errors.generic: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
errors.network: Internet nahi hai. Network dekh kar dobara koshish karein.

validation.phoneInvalid: Durust Pakistani mobile number likhein, jaise 0300 1234567.

states.errorBody: Yeh load nahi ho saka. Internet dekh kar dobara koshish karein.
states.offlineBody: Iske liye internet chahiye. Internet aate hi yeh load ho jayega.
states.offlineBanner: Internet nahi hai. Haaliya safhat dekh sakte hain, save karne ke liye internet chahiye.
states.notFoundBody: Yeh safha mojood nahi ya kahin aur muntaqil ho gaya hai.

offlinePage.title: Aap offline hain
offlinePage.body: TezDukan abhi internet tak nahi pohanch pa rahi. Haal hi mein khole gaye safhat ab bhi dekhe ja sakte hain.

settings.languageHint: App ki zubaan foran badal jaati hai.
settings.darkModeHint: Raat ko aankhon ke liye aaram deh.
settings.matchDeviceHint: Phone ka light ya dark mode apnayein.

command.title: Talaash aur commands
command.description: Kisi safhe par jayein, setting badlein ya Munshi se poochein.
command.placeholder: Talaash karein ya Munshi se poochein…
command.empty: Kuch nahi mila. Munshi se poochne ke liye Enter dabayein.

munshi.title: Munshi
munshi.subtitle: Urdu, Roman Urdu ya English mein bol kar ya likh kar poochein.
munshi.greeting: Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main Munshi hoon. Batayein kya kaam hai.

customer.s3: Doodh aur double roti mangwa do

dukandar.s2: Kaunsi cheezein khatam hone wali hain?

distributor.s2: Kis dukan ka payment 30 din se zyada pending hai?
distributor.s3: Is hafte ke top 10 SKU batao

booker.s1: Aaj ki beat ki dukanein dikhao
booker.s2: Kis dukan se payment lena hai?

admin.s1: Kitni dukanein approval ka intezar kar rahi hain?

munshi.notConfigured: Jawab dene ke liye Munshi ko AI key chahiye. TezDukan ka baqi sab kaam maamool ke mutabiq chal raha hai.
munshi.unavailable: Munshi abhi dastiyab nahi. App ke safhat istemal karein, sab kuch maamool ke mutabiq kaam kar raha hai.
munshi.offline: Aap offline hain. Munshi ko internet chahiye, baqi safhat kaam kar rahe hain.
munshi.micDenied: Mic band hai. Browser ki setting mein ijazat dein ya likh kar poochein.

pwa.installBody: App ki tarah kholein, kam internet par bhi.
pwa.iosHint: Share dabayein, phir Add to Home Screen.

subtitle.dukandar: Aapka stock, bill aur khata ek jagah.
